The design took per-core RT args as the knob source and the first implementation was 2.3x slower in replay than necessary; profiled kernel time does not show it.
suggest: Add to the work-distribution / blocking references: prefer CT args + on-device derivation from get_absolute_logical_x/y (or common RT args) over per-core RT args on many-core programs; judge with a trace-replay host-time measurement.
